messages:
elena: Hi folks — quick one: Thurs 2pm onsite interview (Candidate K). We lost our backup scribe. Need someone to own scribe + confirm AV/livestream. Ideally someone in-office for the first 30m. Also need rubric anchor reminder posted. cc @people-ops-bot

gabe: I can cover scribe first 30m, then hop to all-hands at 2:30. happy to do notes and quick highlights.

jordan: I can do remote scribe and capture transcript + action items if Gabe covers live first half. Will set up docs.

ash: AV FYI — Room C projector mic tested earlier today, but livestream token hasn't been rotated. I'll ping infra to refresh creds. Can also bring spare USB mic.

elena: awesome. Gabe + Jordan split sounds good. Gabe can you add your calendar event so people see the handoff? Also Jordan please include rubric link (score anchors) in notes.

gabe: adding event now — calendar link: https://calendar.company/evt/8169876543

jordan: added doc + rubric links: https://docs.company/interviews/candidate-k and https://docs.company/rubric/engineer-sr

people-ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Interview: Candidate K — Thurs 2pm. Scribe owners: gabe (0–30m), jordan (30m–end). AV check scheduled 30m prior. Link: https://calendar.company/evt/8169876543

elena: small checklist before we wrap:
```
- Gabe: bring laptop + spare mic
- Jordan: set up doc & turn on live captions
- Ash: confirm livestream token rotated
- People-ops: post rubric anchor + debrief reminder 10m after
```

ash: livestream token rotated ✅. People-ops team, can you post the debrief reminder with a 10-minute buffer for scoring?

people-ops-bot: Debrief reminder posted to #people-ops and candidate channel; 10-minute post-interview debrief slot reserved.

gabe: will bring mic and be in 5m early.

elena: thanks all — tagging again: @jordan @gabe @ash. If anything changes DM me. :thumbsup:
